title: Spatial radiomics-based interpretable multimodal machine learning model enhances outcomes prediction for minor stroke: A multicenter cohort study.
summary: The multicenter cohort study evaluated the spatial-radiomics and stacked classifiers across development and validation cohorts and reported discrimination metrics. The result is retrospective prognostic performance; it does not establish causal effects or clinical utility.
ai_technology: Spatial radiomics features from CT and clinical variables feed XGBoost and stacked machine-learning classifiers for minor-stroke outcome prediction.
